title: M4A species-mutation foundation
acceptance_criteria: Resolved species changes use target species composition while preserving inherited instance biology and reconciling target chemistry immutably.
Species descriptors and mutation-target lists are immutable and survive profile copy/resolution.
Target choice is uniform over a nonempty list before target resolution; failure, ordering, and strict chance boundary are observable and deterministic where specified.
Species mutation atomically updates genetics and preserves adopted genes while applying target species identity/inherent chemistry.
Native explicit real-catalog cycle produces target species output through normal lifecycle.
Native authenticated existing driver verifies changed species through harvest, powered extraction packet, and normal replant.
Main, JVM-test, and native sources compile and runtime jar is produced.
Report five production targetless profiles, absent authentic mutation edge, open 65-family asset request, and unclaimed four leaves/catalog/special-output completion.
Report bounded foundation and pending full catalog, visual/client, showcase, and owner acceptance; no new manual species scenario is represented.
R8 M3C technical readiness is historical context, not M4A validation or owner acceptance.
manual_steps: No new player-facing species scenario is available: production target lists are empty. Existing /ms14 botany_fixture A/B/C compares harvest modes, not species mutation; do not treat it as species/catalog validation.
